raw.query: WITH best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (variate, resolution, mode) resolution, mode, model FROM provenance.forecast_metrics ORDER BY variate, resolution, mode, wape) SELECT resolution, model, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM best GROUP BY resolution, model ORDER BY resolution, wins DESC;
raw.observed: Fine bins (1s/15s/30s, 24 cells): toto 23, timesfm 1. Coarse bins (45s/1min, 16 cells): toto 6, timesfm 5, chronos 3, ewma 2.
raw.evidence: Chronos wins only 3/16 coarse cells (18.75%); toto and timesfm split coarse bins — claim's second half is contradicted even though toto dominates fine bins.
